openapi: 3.1.0

info:
  title: Garden companion API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: |
    > **This is a sample API spec, not a live API.** The server does not exist,
    > so requests made using the Try It feature will fail with a network error.
    > Use the example responses in each endpoint to see what the API would return.

    The Garden Companion API provides plant information and companion planting
    recommendations to help gardeners plan healthy, productive gardens.

    Companion planting is the practice of growing different plants near each other
    for mutual benefit — improving growth, deterring pests, and making the most
    of garden space.

    ## How to use this sample

    1. Browse the endpoints in the left sidebar.
    2. Open an endpoint to read its description and parameters.
    3. Scroll to **Example** to see a realistic response — for example, `GET /plants/{plantId}`
       shows all companion relationships for tomatoes.
    4. To explore a specific plant, copy an ID from the `GET /plants` example (such as
       `tomatoes-001`) and enter it in the `plantId` field of `GET /plants/{plantId}`.

    ## Base URL

    ```
    https://api.gardencompanion.example.com/v1
    ```

servers:
  - url: https://api.gardencompanion.example.com/v1
    description: Production

tags:
  - name: Plants
    description: Look up plants and their companion relationships.
  - name: Pairings
    description: Browse all beneficial or harmful plant pairings.

paths:
  /plants:
    get:
      operationId: listPlants
      summary: Get all plants
      description: Returns a list of all plants in the database.
      tags:
        - Plants
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A list of plants.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Plant'
              example:
                - id: asparagus-001
                  common_name: Asparagus
                - id: beans-001
                  common_name: Beans
                - id: beets-001
                  common_name: Beets
                - id: cabbage-001
                  common_name: Cabbage
                - id: carrots-001
                  common_name: Carrots
                - id: corn-001
                  common_name: Corn
                - id: cucumbers-001
                  common_name: Cucumbers
                - id: dill-001
                  common_name: Dill
                - id: fennel-001
                  common_name: Fennel
                - id: garlic-001
                  common_name: Garlic
                - id: lettuce-001
                  common_name: Lettuce
                - id: onions-001
                  common_name: Onions
                - id: peas-001
                  common_name: Peas
                - id: peppers-001
                  common_name: Peppers
                - id: potatoes-001
                  common_name: Potatoes
                - id: pumpkins-001
                  common_name: Pumpkins and winter squash
                - id: radishes-001
                  common_name: Radishes
                - id: spinach-001
                  common_name: Spinach
                - id: tomatoes-001
                  common_name: Tomatoes
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/TooManyRequests'

  /plants/{plantId}:
    get:
      operationId: getPlant
      summary: Get a plant
      description: >-
        Returns a plant and all of its companion planting relationships,
        both beneficial and harmful.
      tags:
        - Plants
      parameters:
        - name: plantId
          in: path
          required: true
          description: The unique identifier for the plant.
          schema:
            type: string
            example: tomatoes-001
      responses:
        '200':
          description: The plant and its companion relationships.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PlantWithCompanions'
              example:
                id: tomatoes-001
                common_name: Tomatoes
                companions:
                  - plant:
                      id: asparagus-001
                      common_name: Asparagus
                    relationship: beneficial
                  - plant:
                      id: basil-001
                      common_name: Basil
                    relationship: beneficial
                    reason: Enhances growth and pest resistance.
                  - plant:
                      id: beans-001
                      common_name: Beans
                    relationship: beneficial
                  - plant:
                      id: borage-001
                      common_name: Borage
                    relationship: beneficial
                    reason: Attracts beneficial insects and pollinators.
                  - plant:
                      id: celery-001
                      common_name: Celery
                    relationship: beneficial
                  - plant:
                      id: marigold-001
                      common_name: Marigold
                    relationship: beneficial
                    reason: Reduce whitefly populations.
                  - plant:
                      id: parsley-001
                      common_name: Parsley
                    relationship: beneficial
                    reason: Attracts beneficial insects.
                  - plant:
                      id: radishes-001
                      common_name: Radishes
                    relationship: beneficial
                  - plant:
                      id: rosemary-001
                      common_name: Rosemary
                    relationship: beneficial
                  - plant:
                      id: thyme-001
                      common_name: Thyme
                    relationship: beneficial
                  - plant:
                      id: broccoli-001
                      common_name: Broccoli
                    relationship: harmful
                    reason: Can stunt the growth of nightshades.
                  - plant:
                      id: cabbage-001
                      common_name: Cabbage
                    relationship: harmful
                    reason: Can stunt the growth of nightshades.
                  - plant:
                      id: cauliflower-001
                      common_name: Cauliflower
                    relationship: harmful
                  - plant:
                      id: corn-001
                      common_name: Corn
                    relationship: harmful
                    reason: >-
                      Tomatoes and corn are both heavy feeders and can deplete
                      the soil of nutrients.
                  - plant:
                      id: dill-001
                      common_name: Dill
                    relationship: harmful
                  - plant:
                      id: eggplant-001
                      common_name: Eggplant
                    relationship: harmful
                  - plant:
                      id: fennel-001
                      common_name: Fennel
                    relationship: harmful
                  - plant:
                      id: peppers-001
                      common_name: Peppers
                    relationship: harmful
                  - plant:
                      id: potatoes-001
                      common_name: Potatoes
                    relationship: harmful
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/TooManyRequests'

  /pairings/beneficial:
    get:
      operationId: listBeneficialPairings
      summary: Get all beneficial pairings
      description: >-
        Returns all plants that have at least one beneficial companion,
        along with their beneficial companions and reasons where available.
      tags:
        - Pairings
      responses:
        '200':
          description: All beneficial plant pairings.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/PlantPairing'
              example:
                - plant:
                    id: asparagus-001
                    common_name: Asparagus
                  companions:
                    - plant:
                        id: basil-001
                        common_name: Basil
                    - plant:
                        id: marigold-001
                        common_name: Marigold
                    - plant:
                        id: nasturtium-001
                        common_name: Nasturtiums
                    - plant:
                        id: parsley-001
                        common_name: Parsley
                - plant:
                    id: beans-001
                    common_name: Beans
                  companions:
                    - plant:
                        id: corn-001
                        common_name: Corn
                      reason: >-
                        Provides a natural trellis for climbing beans and
                        improves sunlight access.
                    - plant:
                        id: lovage-001
                        common_name: Lovage
                      reason: >-
                        Attracts beneficial insects such as parasitoid wasps
                        that prey on aphids and beetles.
                    - plant:
                        id: rosemary-001
                        common_name: Rosemary
                      reason: Repels common garden pests with natural aromatic compounds.
                    - plant:
                        id: sunflower-001
                        common_name: Sunflowers
                      reason: >-
                        Provides a natural trellis for climbing beans and
                        improves sunlight access.
                - plant:
                    id: beets-001
                    common_name: Beets
                  companions:
                    - plant:
                        id: beans-001
                        common_name: Bush beans
                      reason: Fixes nitrogen in the soil, improves fertility.
                    - plant:
                        id: garlic-001
                        common_name: Garlic
                      reason: Improves beet growth and flavor.
                    - plant:
                        id: lettuce-001
                        common_name: Lettuce
                      reason: Complements root depth and suppresses weeds.
                    - plant:
                        id: onions-001
                        common_name: Onions
                      reason: Reduces pest pressure and improves yields.
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/TooManyRequests'

  /pairings/harmful:
    get:
      operationId: listHarmfulPairings
      summary: Get all harmful pairings
      description: >-
        Returns all plants that have at least one harmful companion,
        along with their harmful companions and reasons where available.
      tags:
        - Pairings
      responses:
        '200':
          description: All harmful plant pairings.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/PlantPairing'
              example:
                - plant:
                    id: asparagus-001
                    common_name: Asparagus
                  companions:
                    - plant:
                        id: fennel-001
                        common_name: Fennel
                    - plant:
                        id: garlic-001
                        common_name: Garlic
                      reason: Can inhibit growth of asparagus.
                    - plant:
                        id: onions-001
                        common_name: Onions
                      reason: Can inhibit growth of asparagus.
                    - plant:
                        id: potatoes-001
                        common_name: Potatoes
                - plant:
                    id: beans-001
                    common_name: Beans
                  companions:
                    - plant:
                        id: broccoli-001
                        common_name: Broccoli
                    - plant:
                        id: cauliflower-001
                        common_name: Cauliflower
                    - plant:
                        id: chives-001
                        common_name: Chives
                      reason: Can inhibit growth of beans.
                    - plant:
                        id: garlic-001
                        common_name: Garlic
                      reason: Can inhibit growth of beans.
                    - plant:
                        id: kale-001
                        common_name: Kale
                    - plant:
                        id: leeks-001
                        common_name: Leeks
                      reason: Can inhibit growth of beans.
                    - plant:
                        id: onions-001
                        common_name: Onions
                      reason: Can inhibit growth of beans.
                - plant:
                    id: beets-001
                    common_name: Beets
                  companions:
                    - plant:
                        id: beans-001
                        common_name: Pole beans
                      reason: The two plants can stunt each other's growth.
        '429':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/TooManyRequests'

components:
  schemas:
    Plant:
      type: object
      description: A plant in the database.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Unique identifier for the plant.
          example: tomatoes-001
        common_name:
          type: string
          description: The plant's common name.
          example: Tomatoes

    Companion:
      type: object
      description: A companion planting relationship.
      properties:
        plant:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Plant'
        relationship:
          type: string
          enum: [beneficial, harmful]
          description: |
            The relationship between the two plants.

            - `beneficial` — These plants benefit each other in some manner. Plant them near each other when possible.
            - `harmful` — These plants damage the well-being of one plant or the other. Do not plant them near each other.
          example: beneficial
        reason:
          type: string
          description: An explanation of why this pairing works or doesn't.
          example: Enhances growth and pest resistance.

    PlantWithCompanions:
      type: object
      description: A plant and all of its companion relationships.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Unique identifier for the plant.
          example: tomatoes-001
        common_name:
          type: string
          description: The plant's common name.
          example: Tomatoes
        companions:
          type: array
          description: All companion relationships for this plant.
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Companion'

    PairingCompanion:
      type: object
      description: A companion plant in a pairing, with an optional reason.
      properties:
        plant:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Plant'
        reason:
          type: string
          description: An explanation of why this pairing works or doesn't.
          example: Attracts beneficial insects and pollinators.

    PlantPairing:
      type: object
      description: A plant and its companions of a single relationship type.
      properties:
        plant:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Plant'
        companions:
          type: array
          description: Plants in this pairing relationship.
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/PairingCompanion'

    Error:
      type: object
      description: A standard error response.
      properties:
        code:
          type: integer
          description: The HTTP status code.
          example: 404
        message:
          type: string
          description: A human-readable description of the error.
          example: Plant not found.

  responses:
    NotFound:
      description: The requested plant does not exist in the database.
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          example:
            code: 404
            message: Plant not found. That plant isn't part of the database.

    TooManyRequests:
      description: The request limit has been exceeded.
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          example:
            code: 429
            message: Request limit exceeded. Try again in 60 seconds.
